caption: The drawing depicts a circular, brown-toned object positioned in the center of an off-white background. In the center of the circle, there is a symmetrical bird with wings extended upward, rendered in a style that emphasizes patterned lines and feather details with darker brown and muted greenish shades. Around the bird, there are three six-pointed stars—one above the bird’s head and two on either side of its body. To the left and right, above the wings, there are distinct characters or letters. Surrounding the bird and decorative elements, the outer edge of the circular object features a border composed of evenly spaced, short, vertical lines. Below the circle, to the right, the name "ALBERT LEVONE" is written in small, uppercase brown letters. The overall composition centers the circular object on a plain sheet with ample empty space around it.
title: Butter Mold
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
